name: Flutter app code check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      flutter: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.flutter }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Filter by paths
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v4
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            flutter:
              - '**/android/**'
              - '**/assets/**'
              - '**/dart_defines/**'
              - '**/golden_test/**'
              - '**/ios/**'
              - '**/lib/**'
              - '**/test/**'
              - '**/web/**'
              - '**/analysis_options.yaml'
              - '**/melos.yaml'
              - '**/pubspec.yaml'
              - '.fvmrc'

  analyze:
    needs: check
    if: ${{ needs.check.outputs.flutter == 'true' && github.event_name != 'push' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Flutter with FVM
        id: setup-flutter
        uses: kuhnroyal/flutter-fvm-config-action/setup@v3

      - name: Prepare Melos
        run: echo "MELOS_SDK_PATH=${{ env.FLUTTER_ROOT }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install Melos
        uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3
        with:
          run-bootstrap: true

      - name: Analyze packages
        run: flutter analyze --fatal-infos

      - name: Check for the existence of unformatted files
        # Cannot use `melos format` as it requires excluding files generated from the target file
        run: melos run format:ci --no-select

  test:
    needs: check
    if: needs.check.outputs.flutter == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Flutter with FVM
        id: setup-flutter
        uses: kuhnroyal/flutter-fvm-config-action/setup@v3

      - name: Prepare Melos
        run: echo "MELOS_SDK_PATH=${{ env.FLUTTER_ROOT }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install Melos
        uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3
        with:
          run-bootstrap: true

      - name: Run package tests
        run: melos run test:ci --no-select

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage/lcov.info

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
